Word Dissection:
- Interdisciplinary: Prefix "inter-" (between/among) + Root "discipline" (branch of knowledge) + Suffix "-ary" (relating to)
- Studies: Root "study" + Suffix "-ies" (plural form)
- Bridge: Root "bridge"
- Gap: Root "gap"
- Between: Prefix "be-" + Root "twixt" (archaic for two) + Suffix "-een" (forming prepositions/adverbs) OR simply Root "between"
- Traditional: Root "tradition" + Suffix "-al" (relating to)
- Academic: Root "academ" + Suffix "-ic" (relating to) + Suffix "-al" (relating to)
- Boundaries: Root "bound" + Suffix "-ary" + Suffix "-ies" (plural)

The Amazon Rainforest is located in South America.
